integrity: Universal argument is analytical; included exhaustive and randomized checks are supplementary and have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: No result for more than four role classes or general friend graphs.
No count of all zero-valued maximizers.
The d=0 specialization has an earlier exact treatment; it is not claimed as new.
Unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk.
scientific_scope: Four possibly empty but sorted friendship-role classes, mutual +1 cross-class and -n within-class values, individually rational partitions, geometric-mean Nash welfare; novelty concerns four nonempty roles.
title: Sharp quartet–triple law for Nash welfare in four-role enemy-averse games
